sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1, Article 3.10 — Wiring Materials and Methods
sources.description: Governs wire insulation types, temperature ratings, conductor materials, and ampacity for different installation methods and environments.

sources.label: PEC 2017, Table 3.10.1.7 — Allowable Ampacities of Insulated Conductors
sources.description: Provides ampacity tables for copper and aluminum conductors based on insulation type, temperature rating, and ambient conditions.

sources.label: PEC 2017, Article 1.10 — Wire Insulation Identification and Color Coding
sources.description: Specifies color coding requirements for electrical wiring: black/red for hot, white for neutral, green/bare for ground.
